description: Adversarial vectors (H4) generated by Alloy from docs/formal/adversarial.als over the threat model threats.als, plus hand-written cases outside the model's facts. kind=replay: one request signed with created/expires (seconds from 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z) and presented at each presented_at, with the expected result per presentation ('ok' or the error code of createKyaAuth, defaults maxSkewSeconds=300, maxTtlSeconds=600, replayCache=memoryReplayCache when replay_cache). kind=freshness: CRL evidence dated this_update, certificate revoked at revoked_at (null = never), checkFreshness at now with max_age_seconds as the ceiling must give ok == expected_ok. kind=cosign: a self-issued company credential with (or without) one e-CPF co-signature; mode=list gives verifyCompanyWill a representatives list that contains the co-signer's CPF iff cosigner_listed, mode=responsible gives acceptCertificateResponsible with the e-CNPJ naming the co-signer iff cosigner_is_responsible; same_text says whether the co-signed text is the challenge; expected is ok or the CompanyWillCode. StaleList and LentECpf are accepted: the library cannot see who left the firm or who holds the token, and the vector records that assumption.
